messages:
Alex Price: Hi folks — putting the final run-of-show for the webinar 'Behind the Scenes: Scaling LLMs for Product Teams'. Need speaker confirm (content + slides) and a rehearsal slot. Quick reads only, pls ✅/✏️.

Priya Gupta: Thanks Alex. I can present the customer case + demo. Posted two short abstract options below; prefer option B.

Sam Li: I can cover serving runtime choices & latency tuning. I have a 20-slide deck but can trim. Will do the tech rehearsal.

Maya Wong: I'll handle the GTM side: registration page, routing, and follow-up flow. Can we confirm which fields we want on the form? I'm leaning toward company size, role, and use-case.

Alex Price: Priya — paste your abstracts here so we can pick. Maya — yes to company size + role + primary use-case. Also add "Are you evaluating a hosted vs self-hosted solution?" as a discrete option.

Priya Gupta: Abstract A (short):
We walk through how product teams get predictable latency and cost from modern LLMs using serving patterns like prefix caching and routing policies. Live demo with a small product prototype.

Abstract B (preferred, slightly punchier):
See the tradeoffs teams actually hit when shipping LLM features — cost, latency, and reliability — and practical levers to control them. Includes a short demo and post-launch checklist for engineers.

Sam Li: Suggest slight edit to B: add "real-world numbers" to the second sentence. e.g., "Includes a short demo and real-world numbers plus a post-launch checklist."

Alex Price: Good call. Updated abstract B -> "See the tradeoffs teams actually hit when shipping LLM features — cost, latency, and reliability — with real-world numbers and practical levers to control them. Includes a short demo and a post-launch checklist for engineers."

Maya Wong: Okay I'll use that copy for the registration page and the meetup description. For lead routing: suggested mapping
- Trial signups & "hosted" answers -> inbound SDR queue
- "Self-hosted" interest -> Solutions Eng (sales assist)
- Enterprise (company size > 1000) -> AE fast-track
Can everyone flag if that works?

Sam Li: Works for me. Also: add a checkbox for "share example workload" so we can collect sample prompt latency/size.

Alex Price: Love it. One more: rehearsal slots tomorrow 10:00-11:00 PT or 16:00-17:00 PT. Which do we pick?

Priya Gupta: 10:00 PT works. I'll join early to test audio.

Sam Li: 10:00 PT for tech run. I'll bring the demo VM and a short smoke test script.

Maya Wong: 16:00 PT is slightly better for me — but I can make 10:00 for the final rehearsal. We should also do a dress rehearsal 24h before the event.

Alex Price: OK locked: tech rehearsal 10:00 PT tomorrow, dress rehearsal same time day-before event. I'll send calendar invites.

ops-bot: Calendar invite created: Webinar rehearsal — Behind the Scenes: Scaling LLMs; 1771320960 -> 1771324560 (10:00-11:00 PT). Organizer: Alex Price.

Priya Gupta: For run-of-show, here's a tight 45-minute plan I think will work (we have a 60-minute slot including Q&A):
```
0:00-0:05 — Welcome + housekeeping (Alex)
0:05-0:20 — Customer story + demo (Priya)
0:20-0:35 — Serving patterns & tuning (Sam)
0:35-0:45 — Live Q&A moderated (Maya + Alex)
0:45-0:50 — Closing + call-to-action (trial link, contact)
```

Sam Li: That looks good. I recommend keeping demo pauses for quick numbers (p95 latencies, tokens/sec) so we can show the impact of batching/quantization.

Maya Wong: I'll prepare the CTA slide and post-webinar nurture sequence. Also setting up HubSpot tags: webinar_behind-the-scenes, interest_hosted, interest_selfhost.

Alex Price: Final asks before I push to the event page tonight:
- Slides by EOD today (Priya, Sam)
- Confirm CTA links (Maya)
- Short speaker bios + headshots (one-liners)
- Any examples you want me to highlight in the promo tweet thread

Priya Gupta: Slides + bio by 6pm PT. Headshot in Drive. Promo blurbs: 1-2 lines about the demo and a stat about latency savings.

Sam Li: Slides in by 5pm PT. I'll add the p95 numbers and a short demo snippet for the promo.

Maya Wong: CTA links will be ready. I'll draft 3 promo copies for Twitter + LinkedIn and share in the #marketing-posts channel tonight.

Alex Price: Awesome. Thanks everyone — I'll update the run-of-show doc and post the event page this evening. If anything changes ping here. :rocket:
